About Axie Infinity

Axie Infinity is a blockchain game in which players collect and battle creatures called Axies. AXS is used for governance, staking and in-game purchases.

Where this AXS price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (AXS-USD), Binance (AXS/USDT) and Kraken (AXS/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
